notes.title: You Can't Scare Me is part of the World Ocean Day Steam Sale!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We are super hyped to have our games in the World Ocean Day Steam Sale!  It’s being organized by Games for Waves, and helps to raise money for the WDC- the Whale and Dolphin Conservation.  They do really important work to help protect the ocean and the creatures in it, so we are so pleased to be taking a part in it.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks so much for checking out the event! [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/worldoceanday2025"] [u]Here’s the link to the showcase itself[/u][/url] so you can check out some other games and support the whales and dolphins even more 🐳[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: You Can't Scare Me is in the Games in NY Festival!
notes.notes:

It's a showcase of games coming straight from the heart of the big apple, and there are a lot of heavy hitters in the mix.  Click on the banner to check out the rest of the festival - it's a really good one!  

A bunch of our LunaBeat games are in the festival too - and available now at a discount!  Check 'em out:

notes.title: You Can't Scare Me has been selected for the Indie Assemble Steam Festival!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,
Some great news to share today, You Can't Scare Me has been selected to participate in the Indie Assemble Steam Fest!  It's running from May 5-11 on Steam, and it's a gathering of the best and brightest new and upcoming releases to show off the power of indie games 🌟

The fest is hosted by [url=https://excaliber.it/en/?snr=1_1056_615_indieassemble_1601]Excaliber[/url], a really cool and dedicated organization dedicated to supporting the growth of the indie space in the video game industry.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44717737-Indie-Assemble/sale/indieassemble]Take a peek through the Indie Assemble Steam page[/url] - there's a lot of really fun indie titles to peruse!

Some of our other games were selected too - here's the full list of LunaBeat games in Indie Assemble:
🏖 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3489070/Cozy_Beach/]Cozy Beach[/url]
🔍 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1114460/Paranormal_Detective_Escape_from_the_80s/]Paranormal Detective: Escape from the 80's[/url]
🕹 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1591150/Paranormal_Detective_Escape_from_the_90s/]Paranormal Detective: Escape from the 90's[/url]
🌧 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1316050/Rainy_City_Pandemic/]Rainy City: Pandemic[/url]
👻 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097210/You_Cant_Scare_Me/]You Can't Scare Me[/url]

Thanks again to Excaliber for hosting the event and including our games! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: You Can't Scare Me is part of the 2025 Women's Day Event!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
We're super proud to announce that You Can't Scare Me has been selected as an official entry for the Steam 2025 Women's Day Sale! We're happy to be shown alongside many other stellar games by women-led dev teams.

We plan to release the game this fall, and we'll have a demo out to try out before then - so wishlist the game today to stay on top of the latest You Can't Scare Me updates!

Thanks so much as always for your spooky support!

-The LunaBeat Team
